bring: Completed audition form (submit at https://forms.gle/pJQh69wEBrgG2gd99 by 6:30 PM on audition night)

activities.notes:
Cabrillo College Theatre Arts production of Sophie Treadwell's Machinal, directed by Robin Aronson. 
Inclusive casting — all students and community actors welcome. 
Rehearsals Tuesday–Friday evenings 6:30–9:30 PM. Performances October 30 – November 15, 2026. 
College credit available (TA 29/529, TA 27/527).

activities.title: Audition Clinic
activities.description:
**Does your monologue or song need a tune-up?**
This clinic can be used for whatever you need, for example, another eye on a monologue, scene, or song, further physical or vocal development of your pieces, or research into new audition material you haven't tried before.
Practice in a private, comfortable space.
